content: go-ds-crdt (the reference Merkle-CRDT KV store SuperGenius's CrdtDatastore is based on) has NO automatic tombstone GC. Deletion is soft (tombstones) only; heads.go/set.go recently added PurgeDAG(ctx,dagName) (PR #341, merged 2025-04): an admin/maintenance hard-delete of ALL state for one named DAG (heads, DAG blocks, set elements, tombstones, value/priority, processed-block markers). Review flagged: concurrent re-broadcast can resurrect heads mid-purge (callers must Close() the Datastore or ensure no active sync), all keys buffered in memory, online DAGGetter must not fetch remote blocks during purge (skip non-local/non-processed), and heads are deleted LAST so a crashed purge is resumable/idempotent. The Merkle-CRDT paper (arXiv 2004.00107, Sec VI-B) leaves GC/compaction as future work and states discarding DAG parts requires knowing every replica is aware of them, which needs replica-set knowledge or an external source of truth such as a blockchain.
